definitions.explanation: The single reproductive female of a bee colony, which lays the eggs and around which the hive is organized. Also used figuratively for a dominant woman at the center of a group.

examples.japanese: {巣|す}には{女王蜂|じょおうばち}が{一匹|いっぴき}いる。
examples.english: There is one queen bee in the hive.

examples.japanese: {女王蜂|じょおうばち}は{卵|たまご}を{産|う}む{役目|やくめ}を{持|も}つ。
examples.english: The queen bee has the role of laying eggs.

examples.japanese: {女王蜂|じょおうばち}がいなくなると、{巣|す}{全体|ぜんたい}が{混乱|こんらん}する。
examples.english: When the queen bee is gone, the whole hive falls into disorder.

notes:
The reproductive female that heads a bee colony. Formed from {女王|じょおう} (queen) + {蜂|はち} (bee), with rendaku turning はち into ばち.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {女王蜂|じょおうばち}が{卵|たまご}を{産|う}む: the queen bee lays eggs
- {女王蜂|じょおうばち}を{中心|ちゅうしん}にした{群|む}れ: a colony centered on the queen bee

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {働|はたら}き{蜂|ばち}: worker bee — a non-reproductive female that gathers food and tends the hive
